# ELK.js

This directory contains the unmodified ELK.js 0.11.0 browser bundle
(`elk.bundled.js`) from https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs/v/0.11.0.

ELK.js and the underlying Eclipse Layout Kernel are third-party software,
provided under the Eclipse Public License 2.0 (see `elk.LICENSE.md`).
Their license is separate from this repository's BSD 3-clause license.

Project, copyright notices, and source:
https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.11.0
https://github.com/eclipse-elk/elk

The original copyright and license notices are retained in the bundle.
